evidence_quotes.quote: Infrastructure as a Catalyst for the Prosperity of African Cities
United Nations Human Settlements Programme(UN-Habitat), P.O.Box 30030, Nairobi 00100, Kenya
This paper investigates how the provision of infrastructure contributes to the prosperity of African cities, using Expert Opinion Survey from a diverse selection of cities.

rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible"): The record metadata specifies 'Three Essays on Education Outcomes and Institutions' by Cristelle Alexandra A. Kouame (2023), but the retrieved PDF text is an entirely different paper: 'Infrastructure as a Catalyst for the Prosperity of African Cities' by Ben Arimah, published in Procedia Engineering 198 (2017) 245-266 (doi: 10.1016/j.proeng.2017.07.159). Because the actual text of Kouame (2023) is not present and zero guessing from title alone is permitted, eligibility under both the narrow 2026-10-13 reading and plain wording of Criterion 2 is set to cannot_tell.
